name: Facet
text: Make the interface dark-themed like Manus and Graphify. A dark background reduces eye strain during long sessions and makes interactive elements pop, improving clarity and liveliness. The trade-off is that some users prefer light themes for readability in bright environments, but we prioritize sustained focus over occasional glare.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail in high-glare environments—users squint at reflections on screens. A system-wide toggle (light/dark/auto) with a one-click switch settles it; we test glare in bright rooms, not just code.
